mapper.update: update test_session set correct_count = #{correctCount}, score = #{score}, ended_date = now() where test_session_id = #{testSessionId}
mapper.select: select test_session_id as testSessionId, member_id as memberId, test_session_type as testSessionType, num_of_question as numOfQuestion, correct_count as correctCount, score as score, started_date as startedDate, ended_date as endedDate from test_session where test_session_id = #{testSessionId}

select d.question_no as questionNo, w.sign_word_name as signWordName, d.user_answer as userAnswer from test_session_detail d join sign_word w on w.sign_word_id = d.sign_word_id where d.test_session_id = #{testSessionId} and d.is_correct = 'N' order by d.question_no
